text:
nora (Product): @channel Launch callout — embed-micro-2026 is GA :sparkles: low-cost embeddings for high-volume use cases.

nora (Product): TL;DR: new model 'embed-micro-2026' optimized for dense retrieval at very low cost, new compact vector format (v2), and a cheap bulk ingestion path (/v1/embeddings:bulk-upload). Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/embed-micro

kevin (Pricing): Important billing note: embed-micro uses a new pricing unit (per-10k vectors) rather than per-token. Existing customers will get a migration credit for first month. I'll post the rate card in the pricing channel in 30m.

diego (ML Eng): A few model notes: embed-micro is quantized to 6-bit and uses feature hashing; it's great for recall and extremely cheap but expect slightly lower semantic fidelity vs embed-large. We've run evals on 12 corpora and most recall metrics hold, per-doc results in the playbook.

sam (DevEx): I'll ship SDK helpers today: python/ts functions for stream_upload + commit_job. Example curl to start a bulk upload: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings:bulk-upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"source":"s3://acme/ingest.ndjson","model":"embed-micro-2026","format":"v2","notify_webhook":"https://hooks.example.com/rcv"}'
```

nora (Product): Operational constraints: default concurrent bulk jobs per-customer = 1 (burst to 3 for paid tiers). Bulk uploads are tracked as jobs and visible in Console -> Jobs. We also added dedupe-by-hash to avoid double-ingesting identical vectors.

diego (ML Eng): Runtime detail for eng-runtime folks: bulk-upload will stream chunks into the sharded worker pool; each chunk is pipelined with the vectorizer and uploader. If you see a spike in small-chunk overhead, tune chunk_size in the bulk-job config.

deploy-bot: Canary started: embed-micro-2026 -> canary-group-a (nodes=15) at 2026-06-08T11:02:03Z. Link: https://ops.redwood.ai/canaries/embed-micro-2026

kevin (Pricing): Also note: we added a trial bucket: first 1M vectors free for new signups. Internal teams can request promo keys from the pricing channel.

sam (DevEx): I'll add a migration snippet for customers on embed-old to compare recall and cost and a short guide for fallbacks if quality doesn't meet thresholds. Will include one-click dashboard queries for anomaly detection.

nora (Product): Migration timeline:
1) Today: GA announcement + docs + SDK helpers.
2) +72hrs: Canary metrics review and early customer invites.
3) +14 days: Default console shows 'try embed-micro' banner for high-volume accounts.
4) +45 days: Optional deprecation of embed-old for new accounts (no hard cutoff).

diego (ML Eng): We need to ensure eval-tracker has baseline comparisons; I'll push a PR with the eval-report referencing embed-old and embed-micro.

kevin (Pricing): Heads-up to CS and Sales: new low-cost tier will change recommended solutions for vector-heavy customers. I'll draft a short FAQ for sales playbooks.

sam (DevEx): Adding quick troubleshooting tips to the docs: common causes for high variance (file encoding, duplicate lines, incorrect format.v2), and a 'verify vectors' helper in SDK that samples vectors and runs a quick sanity check.

nora (Product): Thanks team — marketing will prepare the external GA email tomorrow. For any infra or runtime alerts during canary ping me and diego. :rocket:
